objective: Conversation-based initialization of an independent private local workspace, complete Expert scenario verification, preservation of existing project history during migration, and exact-candidate delivery.
approvalSource: User confirmation of the complete v0.2.0 review in the originating task; the original message and execution evidence are retained privately.
scope: Typed bootstrap and installation configuration usable before a workspace exists
Private editable project root and separate owner-controlled state outside Git
Bundled templates, README and synthetic forward/reverse examples
Expert complete scenario registry, truthful capabilities and executable E2E coverage
Same-machine same-uid consistent backup, restore and explicit relocation lineage
Preserved immutable project assets, Runs, decisions, receipts and evidence
Public product criteria separated from private project execution ledgers
Synchronized documentation, packages, exact-candidate Codex acceptance and conditional Preview release

targets.intent: Freeze scenario coverage and prove workspace-free bootstrap and lossless relocation in isolation
Implement bundled templates, initialization and private project/state binding
Implement complete Expert guidance and all required scenario E2E
Validate backup and relocation, then migrate the existing authorized workspace
Verify the exact installed candidate in Codex and synchronize documentation
Complete CI, four Preview releases, downloaded artifact verification and local installation closure

completion.allRequiredScenarios: PASS with exact-candidate evidence; no missing, skipped, pending or unknown item counts as complete
completion.desktop: Real Codex conversation and tool receipts; fixtures and report structure checks cannot substitute
completion.providerBoundary: Default-install missing-provider guidance and explicitly synthetic configured-provider product tests are reported separately
completion.release: Conditional on full acceptance, exact source CI, reviewed artifact digests, four remote release readbacks and installed verification
completion.evidenceLocation: Private operator-owned audit storage; no private paths, business materials, credentials or acceptance receipts in public packages

exclusions: No modification of original customer project source, tags, releases or production services
No cross-machine or different-uid restore, workspace hot-switch platform, or mixed component version negotiation
No automatic background asset synchronization, arbitrary code/deployment executor, or automatic software version bump from quality warnings
No v1.0 release or second real-project onboarding
No changes to frozen specifications/v1, schemas, compat/vendor bytes or historical governance and acceptance records
